attack_plan.narrative: Reports from the European capital have emerged suggesting unusual activity at the Kremlin, including sightings of white smoke. This has led to speculation about the whereabouts and well-being of President Putin. In recent weeks, Putin has been seen in public less frequently, with his last known appearance being at a closed-door meeting with key military leaders on March 15th. Since then, there has been no official public appearance, raising questions about his health and the stability of his regime. Analysts suggest that this could indicate a power struggle within the Kremlin, possibly involving internal dissent among his allies. A source within the Russian government claims to have received confidential documents indicating that Putin’s allies are plotting against him. Despite this, the Kremlin recently released a new photo featuring Putin alongside U.S. President Obama, suggesting that he remains in good health. However, the sudden cessation of public appearances and the unusual activity at the Kremlin continue to fuel speculation about a potential palace coup.
